title: Falling Trees: A Model Class for Interpretable Risk Prioritization
abstract: arXiv:2609.23780v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many real-world decisions require prioritizing high-risk cases, such as clinicians prioritizing high-risk patients before lower-risk ones. Falling rule lists (FRLs), which are ordered if--then rules with monotonically decreasing risks, provide an interpretable framework for such tasks; however, their single-path structure yields a highly restricted model class. We introduce falling trees, a new family of interpretable models that enforces the same monotonic risk constraint while permitting tree-structured branching. We present GRAVITree, a novel dynamic-programming-with-bounds algorithm for learning the Rashomon set of falling trees under depth and branching constraints. Our formulation can interpolate between rule lists and full decision trees, enabling user-desired model expressivity. translated_title: 坠落树：一种用于可解释风险优先级排序的模型类
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的决策需要对高风险案例进行优先级排序，例如临床医生需要将高风险患者排在低风险患者之前。坠落规则列表（FRL）是一组具有单调递减风险的有序“如果-那么”规则，为此类任务提供了可解释的框架；然而，其单路径结构导致模型类受到高度限制。我们提出了坠落树，这是一类新的可解释模型，它在保持相同单调风险约束的同时，允许树状分支结构。我们提出了GRAVITree，这是一种新颖的带边界动态规划算法，用于在深度和分支约束下学习坠落树的Rashomon集合。我们的方法可以在规则列表和完整决策树之间进行插值，实现用户所需的模型表达能力。在一个新的临床数据集和许多公开的分类基准测试中，坠落树匹配或超越了FRL和其他可解释基线模型，通常……
tldr: 提出坠落树——一种在保持单调递减风险约束的同时允许树状分支的新型可解释模型，并开发GRAVITree算法学习其Rashomon集合，在临床数据和公开基准上匹配或超越坠落规则列表等可解释基线。
en_tdlr: We introduce falling trees, a new interpretable model class enforcing monotonically decreasing risks while permitting tree-structured branching, along with GRAVITree, a dynamic-programming-with-bounds algorithm for learning their Rashomon set, which matches or outperforms falling rule lists and other interpretable baselines on clinical and public benchmark datasets.
